plugins.name: lawcheck
plugins.description: Checks your coding agent's edits against the architecture rules you write: while it writes, before it finishes, and in CI. The plugin sends your agent back, up to three times, while the files of its turn break those rules. It gives the agent the law of the repository at the start of every session, checks the file of each edit it makes (with Write, Edit or NotebookEdit in Claude Code, with apply_patch in Codex, with create or edit in Copilot CLI), and checks every file of the turn before the agent finishes. The hooks run Lawcheck and the repository's rule scripts, so use it where you would run the repository's tests. Its skill writes the first law of a repository from its code and asks you before it forbids a use that the code already makes; you start it with /lawcheck:setup in Claude Code and in Copilot CLI, and with $lawcheck:setup in Codex.
